# Wellspring

> Wellspring provides enterprise software solutions for innovation management, intellectual property protection, and technology transfer across R&D organizations.

Wellspring offers an integrated suite of platforms including Accolade for innovation portfolio management, Scout for technology scouting, Evolve for technology transfer, and Astria for IP renewals. The company serves Fortune 500 enterprises across industrial, manufacturing, CPG, defense, aerospace, and chemical sectors.

## Key Topics

- Innovation Management
- Intellectual Property (IP)
- Technology Transfer
- Portfolio Management
- Accolade Platform
- Scout Technology Scouting
- Evolve TTO Management
- Astria IP Renewals
- Product Development
- R&D Optimization
- Time-to-Market
- Invention Disclosure
- Growth Innovation
- Resource Allocation
- Enterprise Software

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Accolade - Enterprise Innovation Management Software](https://www.wellspring.com/en-us/accolade): Accolade enterprise innovation management platform for portfolio & project management
- [Scout Software - Technology Scouting - Innovation Program](https://www.wellspring.com/scout): Scout AI-powered tech scouting platform for innovation & competitive intelligence
- [Evolve - Software for Technology Transfer & Innovation](https://www.wellspring.com/evolve): Evolve tech transfer platform automating research commercialization workflows
- [Astria - IP Renewals & Management Software](https://www.wellspring.com/astria): Astria IP renewals & portfolio management software with managed services
- [Accolade Core | Innovation Management Software](https://www.wellspring.com/accolade-core): Accolade Core archiving & content management for enterprise innovation workflows
- [Flintbox | Wellspring](https://www.wellspring.com/flintbox): Flintbox technology transfer licensing platform for institutional partnerships

## Solution Categories

- [Innovation Management - Corporate Innovation Programs](https://www.wellspring.com/innovation-management): Innovation management platform from ideation to commercialization with analytics
- [Technology Transfer System - TTO Management Software](https://www.wellspring.com/technology-transfer): Evolve TTO management system for disclosures, IP, contracts & finances
- [Technology Scouting Software - Innovation Management](https://www.wellspring.com/tech-scouting): Tech scouting solution with 400M+ patent & startup records for innovation
- [IP Management and Renewals - Intellectual Property Rights](https://www.wellspring.com/ip-management-and-renewals): IP management & renewals automation with portfolio tracking & compliance
- [IP Portfolio Management - Intellectual Property Software](https://www.wellspring.com/portfolio-management): Portfolio management solution for IP workflow optimization & ROI maximization
- [Growth Innovation - Innovative Management Solutions](https://www.wellspring.com/growth-innovation): Growth Innovation product overview for enterprise R&D and product development
